description:
Build the dependency graph's reverse-dependency index once per graph in the graph module, and make archive planning take every graph query of a session from one graph, so the per-candidate cost of `jit archive candidates` stops scaling with the dependency graph.

## Background

- The 45d0a971 cost harness (`scripts/benchmark-cost-evidence.sh`, scenario (b)) measures a per-candidate slope of 36.3 ms on the tip against 36.8 ms on base `369d35a42` (ratio 0.99, threshold ≤ 0.5). Without dependencies in the fixture the tip slope is 6.6 ms, so the per-candidate cost scales with the graph. The tip's `config.toml` opens are already constant (4 at C = 10 and C = 40).
- `DependencyGraph::neighbors` (`crates/jit/src/graph/mod.rs`) builds the dependents adjacency on every call, and `get_dependents` pays a reverse lookup per call. Archive planning builds or queries a graph per candidate.
- Invoker ruling: this is the canonical graph primitive that epic `16c53cc2` REQ-06 specifies ("Each graph builds its reverse-dependency index once. Direct dependents, transitive dependents and isolated nodes read that index, and isolated-node detection is O(V+E)."). Build it in the graph module, not as an archive-local index. Scope is what archive planning needs plus REQ-06's own property test; 16c53cc2's traversal unification and cycle detector stay out.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-22 (story `0672b087`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `DependencyGraph` builds its reverse-dependency index once per graph; direct dependents, transitive dependents and isolated nodes read that index, and isolated-node detection is O(V+E).
- [hard] REQ-02: Archive planning, preview, execute and candidate listing build one dependency graph per read or mutation session and plan every target over it; no candidate builds or rebuilds a graph or a reverse index.
- [hard] REQ-03: A `proptest` owns REQ-01 (index-derived dependents, transitive dependents and isolated nodes equal their definitions over arbitrary DAGs); one test owns REQ-02 by observing a single graph construction across a multi-candidate listing.
- [hard] REQ-04: Scenario (b) of the 45d0a971 harness, run against base `369d35a42`, reports a tip per-candidate slope ≤ 0.5 × base in a smoke run; the lead records the run's numbers.

## Notes

- Also satisfies `16c53cc2` REQ-06, which consumes this primitive instead of rebuilding it.
title: Archive planning reads one dependency graph per session whose reverse index is built once
